name: Example: only when a search finds something
description: Every hour, a Search returns results line runs its own small search (any failed logins to Splunk in the last hour?). Only when it returns a row does the next step list the failed logins by user; otherwise that step is skipped and the run still succeeds.

steps.name: Logins in the last hour
steps.spl:
index=_audit action="login attempt"
| stats count BY info

steps.name: Failed logins by user
steps.spl:
index=_audit action="login attempt" info=failed
| stats count AS failures, latest(_time) AS last BY user
| convert ctime(last)
| sort - failures

edges.expression:
index=_audit action="login attempt" info=failed
| stats count
| where count > 0
